workload_lunch_minutes_007.evidence: The teacher shall have a (30) thirty-minute duty-free lunch period.

workload_meetings_limits_008.evidence: No professional development, staff meetings or department/grade level meetings will be scheduled during the hours allotted for teacher workday.

workload_nonteaching_duties_009.evidence: If student supervision is needed before the start of the student day, a teacher may be required to be on duty no more than fifteen (15) minutes five (5) times a week.
